title: LoongArch64 Bring-Up
summary: v1.5 adds a minimal LoongArch64 target while preserving the existing RISC-V target. The release has one purpose: boot FrostVista on QEMU LoongArch64 and run user-space programs.
scope: This is a bring-up release, not a LoongArch feature-parity release.

items.title: Architecture selection
items.description: add `ARCH=loongarch` without changing the default RISC-V build.

items.title: LoongArch toolchain
items.description: define the compiler, ABI, and required compiler flags.

items.title: Separate build outputs
items.description: prevent RISC-V and LoongArch objects from sharing build output.

items.title: Entry assembly
items.description: set the initial stack, clear BSS, and enter C code.

items.title: Linker layout
items.description: define the LoongArch load address, kernel end, and boot stack.

items.title: UART output
items.description: initialize QEMU UART and print the kernel banner.

items.title: Early trap and timer bring-up
items.description: install the kernel trap vector, handle the timer interrupt, and return with `ertn`.

items.title: Basic memory management
items.description: provide the minimal address conversion and page allocation needed by one process. DMW address conversion and the physical memory bounds are defined; the allocator still needs LoongArch validation.

items.title: Exception entry
items.description: enter the kernel from a user exception and dispatch the syscall path.

items.title: User context setup
items.description: construct the initial user context and provide the kernel-to-user transition and user-to-kernel return path.

items.title: User address space
items.description: map one user code region and one user stack.

items.title: User entry and return
items.description: enter user mode and return safely using the LoongArch ABI.

items.title: One syscall
items.description: implement observable syscalls used by the initial user programs.

items.title: User exit
items.description: allow user programs to terminate cleanly.

items.title: Static user binary
items.description: build and load statically linked LoongArch64 user programs.

validation.command: make clean && make ARCH=riscv qemu TEST=runner
A clean build of RISC-V and LoongArch does not reuse stale objects.
